_comment: cli-wikia model registry. Each entry covers the facts wikia needs: the CLI binary name, how to invoke it, where its docs live, and where its hook config + instructions file go. All fields are used by wikia commands (update, hooks, ask). Enforcement and fleet each have their own models.json for their additional fields. When cli-collective is installed, a collective models.json can override any field in all three packages from one place. 'artificial_hooks' marks models where the enforcement engine is deployed with placeholder event names instead of real ones — set to true when has_hook_system is false but enforcement still deploys. Set to false once the CLI gains a real hook system and the wiki gains a hooks.md.  config_dir_env: the environment variable that tool uses to relocate its config root. null means no known variable — wikia then falls back to WIKIA_CONFIG_DIR, which works for every model. Never guess a name here: a wrong variable never fires and is indistinguishable from the user not setting one.

gemini._note: Gemini CLI exposes 7/16 enforcement stages. 9 stages use canonical Claude event names as placeholders until Gemini CLI adds them.

antigravity._note: Antigravity exposes 3/16 enforcement stages. 13 stages use canonical Claude event names as placeholders until Antigravity adds them.

bob._note: Bob 2.0.6 binary verified installed (bob run headless, needs BOB_API_KEY). Settings live at ~/.bob/settings/settings.json (was ~/.config/bob). Bob inherits Claude Code's full 30-event hook system. hook_events() currently returns [] because bob/hooks.md uses inline backtick lists that the wikia regex doesn't parse. artificial_hooks=true until that is fixed; the deployed events are the correct real Claude set.

grok._note: Installed grok 0.0.34 has no hook system. Successor grok-dev 1.1.7 has 17 events matching Claude's names exactly. When grok-dev is detected (wikia gets hooks.md), set has_hook_system=true and artificial_hooks=false and run cli-enforcement sync grok --write.

muse._note: Muse Code 1.4.4. REAL hook system, fire-proven both routes: user (~/.config/muse/settings.json hooks key, Claude-shaped groups) and project (workspace plugin .muse-plugin/plugin.json capabilities.hooks, install --scope project + approve; nesting under .muse/ proven). 20 wire events (MSP schema); 13/16 enforcement stages real, 3 artificial (InstructionsLoaded/ConfigChange/TaskCompleted absent from schema). docs_url=null: no official docs URL used; wiki sourced from --help + MSP schema export + session taxonomy + fire probes (all offline).

qwen._note: Qwen Code 0.24.7 (@qwen-code/qwen-code, npm). Real Claude-compatible hooks firing via messageBus (8 events verified in dist: PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure/Stop/UserPromptSubmit/PermissionRequest/PostToolBatch/Notification). 6/16 enforcement stages real, 10 artificial. docs_url=null: no official docs URL used; wiki sourced from installed dist + --help. -p deprecated upstream in favor of positional prompt. qwen hooks --help prints nothing (managed via /hooks dialog).

aider._note: Aider 0.86.2 (uv tool). No hook system (only git hooks mentioned in --help). No CLI dot-dir: project .aider.conf.yml at root or ~/.aider.conf.yml; .aider staging dir is ours for engine+docs+artificial wiring. CONVENTIONS.md verified x10 in installed package (no AGENTS.md). docs_url=null: wiki sourced from --help + installed package + observed conf.

opencode._note: opencode v2.0.22 (native binary). No JSON hooks surface: plugin API + permission/session event bus exist in-binary (hook.before/after, permission.asked/rejected/replied, session.*) but enforcement cannot attach shell commands via config. .opencode staging dir is ours. AGENTS.md + opencode.json(c) verified in binary strings. docs_url=null: wiki sourced from --help + binary strings + live run probe.

cursor._note: UNVERIFIED/ASSUMED (cursor-agent not installed on maintainer machine; added for ecosystem coverage per user request). Binary/config paths/instruction file are best-effort assumptions. Install cursor-agent, confirm --help + config layout + hook support, then fill ask_template/subcommands, correct paths, set has_hook_system if hooks exist, flip fleet verified, and remove this note.
